user.title: Set up your aquarium
user.description: Create your aquarium in Reef Control.

data_description.aquarium_name: Name used for this aquarium throughout Reef Control.
data_description.volume: Actual water volume after displacement by rock, sand and equipment.
data_description.tank_type: Basic aquarium type used to classify the system.
data_description.supply_system: Method or product system used to supply major and trace elements.
data_description.reef_method: General method used to operate the reef aquarium.

init.title: Configure Reef Control
init.description: Choose the area you want to configure.

entities.title: Equipment & entities
entities.description: Assign the Home Assistant entities that control your aquarium equipment.

data_description.skimmer_entity: Entity that switches the protein skimmer on and off.
data_description.return_pump_entity: Entity that switches the return pump on and off.
data_description.flow_pump_entity: Entity that switches the circulation or flow pump on and off.
data_description.uvc_entity: Entity that switches the UV-C sterilizer on and off.
data_description.light_entity: Entity used to control the aquarium lighting.
data_description.heater_entity: Entity that switches the aquarium heater. Reef Control can use this entity for automatic temperature control.
data_description.ato_entity: Entity that switches the automatic top-off pump. Reef Control can use it for automatic water level control.

water_values.title: Water values
water_values.description: Assign the sensors Reef Control should monitor.

data_description.temperature_entity: Sensor providing the current aquarium water temperature.
data_description.ph_entity: Sensor providing the current pH value.
data_description.water_level_entity: Binary sensor or input boolean used to detect a low water level.

limits.title: Monitoring limits
limits.description: Choose the water parameter whose monitoring limits you want to configure.

temperature_limits.title: Temperature limits
temperature_limits.description: Define the normal range and critical safety limits for temperature.

data_description.temperature_min: Below this value the temperature is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.temperature_max: Above this value the temperature is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.temperature_critical_min: Below this value Reef Control rates the temperature as critical.
data_description.temperature_critical_max: Above this value Reef Control rates the temperature as critical.

ph_limits.title: pH limits
ph_limits.description: Define the normal range and critical safety limits for pH.

data_description.ph_min: Below this value the pH is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.ph_max: Above this value the pH is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.ph_critical_min: Below this value Reef Control rates the pH as critical.
data_description.ph_critical_max: Above this value Reef Control rates the pH as critical.

salinity_limits.title: Salinity limits
salinity_limits.description: Define the normal range and critical safety limits for salinity.

data_description.salinity_min: Below this value the salinity is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.salinity_max: Above this value the salinity is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.salinity_critical_min: Below this value Reef Control rates the salinity as critical.
data_description.salinity_critical_max: Above this value Reef Control rates the salinity as critical.

operating_modes.title: Operating modes
operating_modes.description: Configure how Reef Control controls equipment during feeding and maintenance.

data_description.feeding_duration: How long feeding mode remains active before it ends automatically.
data_description.skimmer_delay: Additional delay before the protein skimmer restarts after feeding mode ends.
data_description.feeding_pause_skimmer: Switch the protein skimmer off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_return_pump: Switch the return pump off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_flow_pump: Switch the flow pump off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_uvc: Switch UV-C off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_ato: Switch automatic top-off off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_skimmer: Switch the protein skimmer off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_return_pump: Switch the return pump off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_flow_pump: Switch the flow pump off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_uvc: Switch UV-C off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_ato: Switch automatic top-off off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_heater: Switch the heater off while maintenance mode is active. Automatic temperature control is paused during maintenance.
data_description.maintenance_pause_light: Switch aquarium lighting off while maintenance mode is active.

temperature_control.title: Temperature control
temperature_control.description: Configure automatic heater control. A temperature sensor and heater must be assigned under Equipment & entities / Water values.

data_description.temperature_control_enabled: Enables Reef Control's automatic heater control.
data_description.temperature_target: Temperature Reef Control should maintain. The heater switches off when this temperature is reached.
data_description.temperature_hysteresis: Prevents frequent switching. Example: with 25.0 °C target and 0.3 °C hysteresis, heating starts at 24.7 °C or below and stops at 25.0 °C or above.
data_description.temperature_min_on_time: After switching on, the heater must remain on for at least this long before Reef Control may switch it off.
data_description.temperature_min_off_time: After switching off, Reef Control waits at least this long before the heater may be switched on again.

reef_icp.title: Reef ICP
reef_icp.description: Link this Reef Control aquarium to a Reef ICP aquarium. The latest ICP data will then be included in Reef Control.

data_description.reef_icp_entry: Select the Reef ICP aquarium whose analysis data belongs to this Reef Control aquarium. Choose no link to disconnect it.

reef_icp_unavailable.title: Reef ICP
reef_icp_unavailable.description: No Reef ICP aquarium was found. Install and configure Reef ICP first.

ato_control.title: Water level control
ato_control.description: Configure automatic top-off. A water-level sensor and ATO pump must be assigned first.

data.ato_low_state: State meaning water level is low

data_description.ato_control_enabled: Enables automatic top-off control by Reef Control.
data_description.ato_low_state: Choose whether ON or OFF from your sensor means that the water level is too low.
data_description.ato_confirm_delay: The water level must remain low for this long before the pump starts. This filters waves and brief sensor changes.
data_description.ato_max_runtime: Hard safety limit for one top-off cycle. When exceeded, the pump is switched off and the controller locks until you turn water level control off and on again.
data_description.ato_cooldown: Minimum waiting time after a completed top-off before another top-off may start.

equipment_control.title: Equipment control
equipment_control.description: Link the return pump, protein skimmer, UV-C and ATO logically. If the return pump stops, Reef Control can safely pause dependent equipment and restart it in a controlled sequence.

data.return_master_skimmer: Make skimmer depend on return pump
data.return_master_uvc: Make UV-C depend on return pump
data.return_master_ato: Make ATO depend on return pump

data_description.equipment_control_enabled: Enables cross-device safety and restart logic.
data_description.return_master_skimmer: Stops the protein skimmer whenever the return pump is not running and restarts it after the configured delay.
data_description.return_master_uvc: Stops UV-C when return flow is unavailable and restarts it after the configured delay.
data_description.return_master_ato: Blocks the ATO pump while the return pump is off. Automatic water-level control is re-evaluated after restart.
data_description.equipment_skimmer_delay: Delay after the return pump starts before a controller-paused skimmer is restarted.
data_description.equipment_uvc_delay: Delay after the return pump starts before controller-paused UV-C is restarted.

error.invalid_limits: Check the limits: critical minimum ≤ normal minimum < normal maximum ≤ critical maximum.
